_comment: ACE-Step extend API workflow: grow an EXISTING take at its head and/or tail (intro / outro) and keep the original untouched. Sibling of acestep_repaint.json - the graph is IDENTICAL apart from node 6, verified 2026-08-16 against the pack's own AEC-extend.json example and ace_step_nodes.py::ACEStepExtend. Same model caveat as repaint: this is the MW pack's ACE-Step 1.0 3.5B, NOT the 1.5 turbo that Compose uses, so grown material is voiced by a different model than the track it extends. HOW IT DIFFERS FROM REPAINT, none of which is cosmetic: (1) there is NO variance input - ACEStepExtend does not expose one, and the pipeline falls back to its own retake_variance default; do not add a `{repaint_variance}` placeholder here expecting it to bind. (2) left/right_extend_length are SECONDS added OUTSIDE the source, which the node converts to repaint_start=-left and repaint_end=duration+right before running task='extend'; the mask therefore covers only NEW territory, so the original audio is not at risk the way a repaint window is. (3) IT CHANGES DURATION - the output is longer than the input, so any verification that assumes equal length (scripts/measure_repaint.py does) must compare only the overlapping original span. (4) Because the new material still draws from the WHOLE song's lyrics, an extension can repeat a verse rather than continue it; that is measured per-run, not assumed. WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT TEMPLATED, identical to the repaint sibling: node 5 audio_duration is inert (overwritten from the source file), node 5 seed must stay NONZERO via {param_seed} or the run dies TypeError after loading 7.6GB, and node 6 overlapped_decode stays false.
